final_verification.result: 13/13 generated builders produced SMGR provenance sidecars and passed Magic DRC plus Netgen LVS.

CurrentMirrorPtype.repair_note: The source .convo routed mirror_source_E to itself; this builder connects reference_source_E to mirror_source_E.

Inverter.repair_note: Output routing uses the east-side source/drain ports to avoid shorting the gate net into the output net during Magic extraction.

LowNoiseAmp.repair_note: The source .convo said 'move gain below' without an anchor; this builder uses gain below input.

ULPD.repair_note: Uses explicit body ties and shared NMOS bulk handling so the netlist matches Magic's substrate extraction.

Varactor.repair_note: Uses single-finger NMOS devices and smart local drain/source shorts so the MOSCAP terminal merges cleanly under LVS.
